# RU-CENTER (nic.ru)
> Russian domain registrar and hosting provider offering domains, DNS, SSL, websites, email, cloud, and server services.

RU-CENTER provides domain registration and management alongside infrastructure and web services for individuals and businesses in Russia. Its site includes product information, support materials, service management entry points, and legal and company resources.

## Domains
- [Domain Registration](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/domains/): Main domain registration catalog with TLD options and pricing.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/domains/transfer/): Information about transferring domains to RU-CENTER.
- [Premium Domains](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/domains/premium/): Premium and valuable domain name offerings.
- [Expired Domains](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/domains/release/): Released and expiring domains available for registration.
- [Domain Backorder](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/domains/backorder/): Service for attempting registration of desired domains when released.
- [WHOIS](https://www.nic.ru/whois/): Domain WHOIS lookup for registration and delegation data.
- [Domain Zones](https://www.nic.ru/help/domains/): Help and reference materials for domain registration topics.

## Hosting and Websites
- [Hosting](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/hosting/): Shared hosting plans for websites and web applications.
- [VPS/VDS](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/vds/): Virtual private server offerings with configurable resources.
- [Dedicated Servers](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/dedicated/): Dedicated server rental for high-load projects.
- [Website Builder](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/site/): Website creation service for small business and personal sites.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/hosting/wordpress/): Hosting optimized for WordPress-based websites.
- [CMS Hosting](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/hosting/cms/): Hosting plans tailored for common content management systems.

## Cloud and Infrastructure
- [Cloud Services](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/cloud/): Cloud infrastructure services for deploying and scaling applications.
- [Object Storage](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/cloud/storage/): Cloud storage service for files, backups, and static assets.
- [Load Balancer](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/cloud/balancer/): Traffic distribution service for improving availability and performance.
- [Virtual Data Center](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/cloud/vdc/): Virtualized infrastructure environment for enterprise workloads.
- [Backup](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/cloud/backup/): Backup services for protecting servers and hosted data.

## Security and Certificates
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/ssl/): SSL/TLS certificate catalog for securing websites and services.
- [DNS Hosting](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/dns/): Managed DNS hosting for domain zones and records.
- [Anti-DDoS](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/anti-ddos/): Protection services against distributed denial-of-service attacks.
- [Site Protection](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/security/): Security-related offerings for websites and online infrastructure.

## Email and Collaboration
- [Business Email](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/mail/): Email hosting for domains and business communication.
- [Mail for Domain](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/mail/domain/): Domain-based mailbox service for organizations and teams.
- [Email Protection](https://www.nic.ru/catalog/mail/antispam/): Anti-spam and mail security features for hosted email.

## Support and Help
- [Help Center](https://www.nic.ru/help/): Main support knowledge base and service instructions.
- [Domain Help](https://www.nic.ru/help/domains/): Articles about domain registration, transfer, and management.
- [Hosting Help](https://www.nic.ru/help/hosting/): Documentation and troubleshooting for hosting services.
- [SSL Help](https://www.nic.ru/help/ssl/): Guidance for ordering, installing, and renewing certificates.
- [Payment Help](https://www.nic.ru/help/pay/): Information about billing, payments, and financial documents.
- [Contacts](https://www.nic.ru/about/contacts/): Contact information for support and company departments.

## Account and Service Management
- [Personal Account](https://www.nic.ru/login/): Login page for managing domains and subscribed services.
- [Service Renewal](https://www.nic.ru/pay/): Payment and renewal entry point for active services.
- [Order Services](https://www.nic.ru/order/): General order flow for RU-CENTER products and services.
- [Cart](https://www.nic.ru/order/cart/): Shopping cart for selected services and products.

## Company and Legal
- [About RU-CENTER](https://www.nic.ru/about/): Company overview and general information.
- [News](https://www.nic.ru/news/): Company and industry news updates.
- [Promotions](https://www.nic.ru/action/): Current discounts, campaigns, and special offers.
- [Partners](https://www.nic.ru/about/partners/): Information for partners and cooperation programs.
- [Documents](https://www.nic.ru/about/documents/): Official documents, agreements, and service terms.
- [Requisites](https://www.nic.ru/about/details/): Company legal details and requisites.

## Business Services
- [Services for Business](https://www.nic.ru/business/): Overview of RU-CENTER solutions for companies and organizations.
- [Corporate Domains](https://www.nic.ru/business/domains/): Domain portfolio services for corporate customers.
- [Corporate Hosting](https://www.nic.ru/business/hosting/): Hosting and infrastructure solutions for business websites.
- [Managed Services](https://www.nic.ru/business/services/): Additional operational and support services for business clients.
- [Reseller Program](https://www.nic.ru/partner/): Partner and reseller opportunities for selling services.
